# Number of IS found
## Initial running

Initial findings using fasta
- Fasta: found only 38 IS [4 unique IS]
    - Suspected because there only 3 contigs and eris used those long contigs to analyse the data
- More IS found using GFA

## Fragmentation
When I looked at the data, I found that the assembly graph are more fragmented compared to the fasta file. That is why I fragmented it.

In result: More IS found after fragmentation

## Sorting 
We played around sorting in the `pipeline.py` in the function `_build_local`

The result is below:
| Total IS | Complete | Simulated | Fragmented |
|---------|:-----|------|------:|
| Total rows | 37 | 293 | 212 |
| Total unique IS | 4 | 35 | 24 |

However, after we sorted it we found:

| Total IS | Complete (fa) | Simulated (gfa)|
|---------|-----|------|------:|
| Total rows | 513 |343 |
| Total unique IS | 38 | 40 |
